name: code-type
body: A source file's provenance class, computed by the ingestor from the path plus the project classification config. The built-in classes are `src`, `test`, `generated`, `external` and `docs` — `docs` is the markdown arm of the built-in classifier (ordinary markdown documents and their section symbols), not a project-defined value. A project may also define its own values via `apg/config.json`. An `apg/config.json` replaces the built-ins entirely: with a config present the first matching rule wins, else the config's `default` — so a config with no `docs` rule classifies markdown as that `default` (which itself defaults to `src`), never `docs`. All code is included in the graph; code type is the filter. The built-in classifier also carries a `py` arm for Python sources (test = *_test.py / test_* / *.test.py or a test|tests|__tests__ segment; generated = *.pyi or __pycache__|gen|generated; external = vendor|third_party|thirdparty|site-packages), see requirements.requirement.python-code-type.
